items.quote: But what happens in between those two points? Mystery. Magic. Bermuda Triangle. No visibility. No structure. No control.
items.statement: Most businesses lack structure in tracking performance between leads and closed deals.

items.quote: But when I ask: “What’s the benchmark?” “What’s the actual conversion rate?”
items.statement: Businesses often do not know their actual conversion rates from leads to meetings.

items.quote: They know performance is below expectations.
items.statement: Companies perform below expectations but do not have clear benchmarks to improve.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing sales performance and conversion rates in real estate.
